en.headline: MTR Island Line delayed again by HKU station signal fault
en.dek: The operator said a signalling fault near HKU station added five to eight minutes to journeys for about an hour during Thursday morning rush hour before services returned to normal.
body: The MTR Corporation said a signalling equipment fault near Hong Kong University station disrupted Island Line services on Thursday morning for a second consecutive day.

Trains had to slow down through the affected section, adding an estimated five to eight minutes to end-to-end journeys from about 7:43am until the fault was repaired around 8:38am, the operator said. Services then gradually returned to normal.
The MTR apologised to passengers and advised them to allow extra travelling time. A similar fault on Wednesday had caused longer disruption and queues at stations including North Point.

zh.headline: 港鐵港島綫香港大學站信號故障連續兩日影響繁忙時間
zh.dek: 港鐵表示，周四早上香港大學站附近信號故障令整體車程額外增加五至八分鐘，約一小時後修復，服務陸續恢復正常。
body: 港鐵公司表示，周四早上香港大學站附近再次出現信號設備故障，港島綫列車行經該路段需慢駛，整體車程額外增加五至八分鐘。
故障約於上午七時四十三分至八時三十八分期間持續約一小時，其後已修復，列車服務陸續恢復正常。港鐵向乘客致歉，並呼籲預留充裕時間。
周三亦曾發生類似故障，導致較長時間延誤及車站出現人龍。
